<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F4F5F7"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="30" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="24" y="20" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">9:41</text>
    <line x1="318" y1="15" x2="322" y2="15" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="318" y1="15" x2="318" y2="20" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="324" y1="12" x2="324" y2="20" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="330" y1="9" x2="330" y2="20" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="344" cy="15" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="347" y1="18" x2="350" y2="21" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <rect x="357" y="9" width="24" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <rect x="360" y="12" width="16" height="6" rx="1" fill="#00C6AE"/>
    <rect x="382" y="13" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#18191F"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="30" width="390" height="70" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="31,64 23,70 31,76" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="24" y1="70" x2="42" y2="70" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="55" y="78" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="24" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Saved Payments</text>
    <line x1="0" y1="99" x2="390" y2="99" stroke="#EEEFF4" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Balance card shadow and card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="25" y="108" width="342" height="112" rx="16" fill="#18191F" opacity="0.16"/>
    <rect x="24" y="104" width="342" height="112" rx="16" fill="#1947E5" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="48" y="137" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">AVAILABLE BALANCE</text>
    <text x="48" y="180" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="36" font-weight="800" fill="#FFFFFF">$5,665.99</text>
    <text x="48" y="201" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Ready for your next payment</text>
    <circle cx="329" cy="132" r="13" fill="#FFBD12" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="324" y1="132" x2="334" y2="132" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="329" y1="127" x2="329" y2="137" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Section title -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="252" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="21" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Payment methods</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="291" y="232" width="75" height="32" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="329" y="253" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Manage</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- First payment card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="25" y="279" width="342" height="148" rx="16" fill="#18191F" opacity="0.17"/>
    <rect x="24" y="275" width="342" height="148" rx="16" fill="#FFBD12" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="48" y="307" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="17" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">VISA</text>
    <rect x="48" y="326" width="42" height="28" rx="5" fill="#FFF4CC" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="54" y1="335" x2="84" y2="335" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="54" y1="342" x2="84" y2="342" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="108" y="348" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">•••• 4242</text>
    <text x="48" y="389" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">Alex Morgan</text>
    <text x="270" y="389" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#18191F">EXP 09/28</text>
    <rect x="292" y="294" width="48" height="20" rx="10" fill="#00C6AE" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="316" y="308" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="11" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">DEFAULT</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Second payment card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="25" y="449" width="342" height="148" rx="16" fill="#18191F" opacity="0.17"/>
    <rect x="24" y="445" width="342" height="148" rx="16" fill="#00C6AE" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="48" y="477" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="17" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">mastercard</text>
    <circle cx="70" cy="505" r="14" fill="#F95A2C" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="86" cy="505" r="14" fill="#FFBD12" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="119" y="511" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">•••• 8817</text>
    <text x="48" y="559" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">Alex Morgan</text>
    <text x="270" y="559" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#18191F">EXP 03/27</text>
    <rect x="48" y="573" width="79" height="20" rx="10" fill="#D6FCF7" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="87" y="587" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="11" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">PERSONAL</text>
    <circle cx="337" cy="573" r="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="337" cy="568" r="2" fill="#18191F"/>
    <circle cx="337" cy="574" r="2" fill="#18191F"/>
    <circle cx="337" cy="580" r="2" fill="#18191F"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Add payment method -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="646" r="29" fill="#18191F" opacity="0.18"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="642" r="29" fill="#F95A2C" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="183" y1="642" x2="207" y2="642" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="195" y1="630" x2="195" y2="654" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="696" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="13" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Add payment method</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Helpful footer content -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="712" width="342" height="1" fill="#9FA4B4"/>
    <circle cx="39" cy="731" r="9" fill="#E9E7FC" stroke="#1947E5" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="39" y="735" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#1947E5">i</text>
    <text x="56" y="735" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#474A57">Your payment information is encrypted.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="764" width="390" height="80" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="764" x2="390" y2="764" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g>
      <polygon points="48,786 58,778 68,786 68,800 48,800" fill="none" stroke="#969BAB" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="48,786 58,778 68,786" fill="#969BAB"/>
      <text x="58" y="823" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#969BAB">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="137" cy="788" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#1947E5" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="137" y1="782" x2="137" y2="794" stroke="#1947E5" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="131" y1="788" x2="143" y2="788" stroke="#1947E5" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="137" y="823" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="11" font-weight="800" fill="#1947E5">Payments</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="215" y="779" width="20" height="17" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#969BAB" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polyline points="219,779 219,775 231,775 231,779" fill="none" stroke="#969BAB" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="219" y1="785" x2="231" y2="785" stroke="#969BAB" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="225" y="823" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#969BAB">Activity</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="319" cy="784" r="6" fill="#969BAB"/>
      <ellipse cx="319" cy="799" rx="12" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#969BAB" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="319" y="823" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#969BAB">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
